constraints: MCP requires allow-edits and receives a typed object; CLI --save-preferences reads --preferences plus quantity overrides. Both require the current digest for updates.

capabilities.reason: Both generate catalog-derived product BOMs, harness schedules and review views.
constraints: MCP always creates a fresh build/views/<view_id>; CLI also supports its existing configured output locations. Both accept the same project/product/tag union and exclusions.

capabilities.reason: Both assemble a retained review manifest and evidence.

capabilities.reason: Both run pinned KiCad WRL and STEP comparison views for an exact sourced part and preserve REVIEW instead of physical-fit approval.
